task.description:
Update documentation after EE-11 (State reconstruction) release.

1. Update docs/status/requirement_status.json: set EE-11 status = RELEASED, set released_at to current UTC timestamp, set release_run = WF02-ee11-20260522.
2. Update CHANGELOG.md: add entry under Stage 3 for EE-11 — State reconstruction (reconstructInstance function, POST /instances/{id}/reconstruct endpoint, NFR-04 compliance, spans events + events_archive tables).
3. Run retrospective for WF02-ee11-20260522 per docs/agents/metrics.md §6: read estimation.json, compute actual times from started_at/completed_at fields in each step handoff, compare estimated vs actual, check whether any step has |variance_pct| > 25%, update estimation_rules.json if needed, write docs/metrics/retrospectives/WF02-ee11-20260522.json.
4. Update this handoff's status to COMPLETED with result.status = PASS.
acceptance_criteria: docs/status/requirement_status.json has EE-11 status = RELEASED with released_at and release_run set
CHANGELOG.md has an EE-11 entry describing state reconstruction, reconstructInstance, and POST /instances/{id}/reconstruct
estimation_rules.json updated if any step variance > 25% across ≥2 consecutive runs at same difficulty

result.summary: Updated EE-11 status to RELEASED in requirement_status.json; added EE-11 State Reconstruction entry to CHANGELOG.md (reconstructInstance, POST /instances/{id}/reconstruct, NFR-04 compliance, events + events_archive span); ran WF02-ee11-20260522 retrospective (D4, actual=34.42 min vs est=62 min, -44.5% variance); adjusted D4 estimates for code-designer (12->10), test-designer (16->11), release-validator (3->2) in estimation_rules.json.
